recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body portrait of a male figure in urban streetwear positioned on the left, set against a vertically paneled, weathered metal wall. The right side is dominated by large, stacked, textured block lettering with a secondary line of distressed slab-serif text below it.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject on the left balanced by heavy typography on the right
Vertical lines of the metal wall echoing the verticality of the subject
High-contrast lighting on the subject against a mid-tone industrial backdrop
Textured overlays across both image and type to create a unified gritty feel
coreInvariants: Corrugated or paneled metal background with visible rivets/seams
Stacked primary title in heavy sans-serif
Distressed texture applied to the typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body figure occupying the left third of the frame, scaled to nearly the full height of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and sunglasses serve as the primary anchor, followed by the large white block text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down the body, then shifts right to the large title, and finally down to the secondary red text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The center-right portion of the metal wall provides breathing room between the subject and the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cool greys and metallic silver tones in the background and subject's clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for the primary display text to ensure legibility against the grey wall.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep red for the secondary title line to provide a focal pop of color.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Desaturated overall palette with high value contrast between the white text and the shadows of the subject.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold geometric sans-serif and heavy slab-serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary text: Thick, blocky strokes with minimal kerning; letters appear stamped or cut from metal.
Secondary text: Slab-serif with distressed, eroded edges resembling a stencil or rubber stamp.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Inner counters of letters like 'O' and 'D' are slightly squared off.
Surface of the letters contains a metallic, scratched texture overlay.

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over background, adjacent to subject

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a clean, massive sans-serif with a smaller, textured slab-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary blocky, heavy presence for the primary title.
Matches the slab-serif structure and industrial feel of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a full-body portrait of a man in urban streetwear (sunglasses, fur-collared vest, dark jeans) standing with arms crossed on the left side of the frame. The background is a weathered, vertically-paneled grey metal wall with rivets and subtle grunge textures. Leave the right half of the frame relatively clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, stacked white block text in a heavy sans-serif font in the upper right quadrant. Below it, add a single line of spaced-out, distressed red slab-serif text. Apply a subtle metallic texture and drop shadow to the white text and a stamped/eroded effect to the red text.

verificationChecks: Is the subject positioned on the left?
Is the background a metallic industrial wall?
Is the primary text white and extremely bold?
Is the secondary text red and distressed?

adjustableVariables: Specific color of the accent text
Number of panels in the background
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos
Parental advisory sticker (replace with generic warning if needed)
Specific jewelry or brand logos on clothing
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the texture on the text matches the background grit.
Check that the red text is legible against the grey wall.
Verify the subject's lighting matches the environment.
Confirm the stacked text does not overlap the subject's head.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Industrial Metal Backdrop + Stacked Heavy Sans-Serif + Distressed Slab-Serif Accent = Gritty Street Aesthetic
